summary.text: Prophecy takes place on Jamuraa and in the frozen land of Keld, where the Keldons launch the Prophecy War by raiding the Jamuraan coast, taking hostages and settling, while the Kipamu League is unable to resist.

It follows Latulla, who is placed in command of the war but is defeated in ritual combat by Gorsha at the Keldon Necropolis and exiled, and Teferi and Barrin, who reorganize the League and destroy her banished followers.

The war ends in the shadow of the coming Phyrexian invasion, as Phyrexian necromancy raises the Keldon dead as thralls at the Necropolis and the survivors sail on to Urborg for the final battle against Yawgmoth.
